product.title: Ce nu știa Darwin
product.description: Teoria selecției naturale a lui Darwin ne explică exact cum sunt păstrate pe parcursul timpului adaptările folositoare. Dar Darwin nu a reușit să iși dea seama care este cel mai mare mister al evoluției. După cum spunea pionierul geneticii, Hugo de Vries, bdquo;selecția naturală poate explica supraviețiurea celui mai puternic, dar nu poate explica apariția celui mai puternicldquo;. Pot mutațiile genetice, care au avut loc intr-un interval de 3,8 miliarde de ani, să fie cu adevărat responsabile de apariția aripilor, a globilor oculari, a genunchilor, a capacității de camuflare și de digerare a lactozei, de fotosinteză și de restul minunilor create de natură? Și, dacă răspunsul este nu, care este mecanismul care explică viteza și eficiența evoluției? Icirc;n Ce nu știa Darwin, renumitul biolog Andreas Wagner face rezumatul a cincisprezece ani de cercetări pentru a prezenta piesa lipsă din teoria lui Darwin. Folosind tehnologii experimentale și computaționale de neimaginat pacirc;nă acum, el a descoperit că adaptările nu sunt doar rezultatul hazardului, ci al unui set de legi care ii permit naturii să descopere noi molecule și mecanisme intr-o fracțiune din timpul necesar unor variații intacirc;mplătoare.

# What Darwin Didn't Know: Unraveling the Mysteries of Evolution

Dive deep into the profound questions surrounding evolution with *What Darwin Didn't Know*, a book that explores the gaps in classical evolutionary theory and introduces the cutting-edge science behind biological change. Published by Litera, this book invites you to discover the mechanisms that truly drive adaptation and evolution.

## The Unanswered Questions of Natural Selection

While Charles Darwin laid the foundation for our understanding of natural selection, he left a significant mystery unresolved: how exactly do genetic mutations lead to the vast array of adaptations we see in nature? This book tackles the central puzzle that scientists are still actively investigating today.

## Discovering the Missing Piece

The author, renowned geneticist Andreas Wagner, summarizes fifteen years of cutting-edge research to present the missing piece of Darwin's theory. Through experimental and computational technologies, Wagner reveals that adaptations are not solely the result of chance, but rather the outcome of a set of laws that allow nature to discover new molecules and mechanisms in a fraction of the time required by traditional models.

This book bridges the gap between classical biology and modern genetics, offering an illuminating perspective on the speed and efficiency of evolutionary processes.

## Why Read This Book?

*   **Examine Evolution Deeper:** Explore the limits of Darwinian thought and see how modern genetic understanding refines our view of natural selection.
*   **Understand Modern Mechanisms:** Discover the role of genetic mutations and molecular mechanisms in driving biological adaptation.
*   **Meet the Science:** Learn from the research of Andreas Wagner as he presents a comprehensive summary of contemporary evolutionary science.

**Get your copy today and start exploring the true story of evolution.**

[Buy "What Darwin Didn't Know" on Litera](https://www.litera.ro/ce-nu-tia-darwin)

***

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: What is the main focus of this book?**
A: The book focuses on the gaps in Charles Darwin's theory regarding how genetic mutations lead to biological adaptations and the mechanisms behind the speed and efficiency of evolution.

**Q: Who is the author of this book?**
A: The book is based on the research summary by renowned geneticist Andreas Wagner.

**Q: Is this book for biology students or general readers?**
A: This book is designed to be accessible to a broad audience interested in science, offering an engaging overview of complex evolutionary concepts.

***
